description: This plot illustrates the validation performance of two models over time. The x-axis is labeled "Training Steps $(\times 10^3)$", featuring a linear scale with values ranging from 0 to 50 and tick marks at intervals of 10. The y-axis is labeled "BPC", utilizing a linear scale with a visible range from approximately 1.1 to 2.2 and tick marks spaced every 0.2 units. The plot contains two lines representing different validation metrics. The first line, labeled "SMoE Validating", is a solid black line with cross markers. It begins at an x-value of 0 with a y-value of approximately 1.68. The line exhibits a sharp initial decline, reaching roughly 1.28 at x=10, followed by a more gradual decrease to about 1.20 at x=19. After a small drop to approximately 1.17 at x=20, the line maintains a steady, slightly fluctuating trend, ending at approximately 1.14 at x=50. The second line, labeled "SimSMoE Validating", is a solid purple line with dot markers. It starts at x=0 with a higher initial y-value of approximately 2.16. It experiences a steep initial decline, dropping to roughly 1.26 at x=10 and 1.19 at x=19. Following a slight decrease to about 1.15 at x=20, the line remains relatively stable with minor fluctuations through the remainder of the plot, concluding at approximately 1.11 at x=50.
